Hi Sofia — thanks for sending these over. Quick notes so we can progress to a conditional PO: 

1) Endorsement wording we need on the COI (insurance carrier endorsement page or separate endorsement):
   - "Redwood Inference, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates and their officers, directors and employees are named as Additional Insured on a primary and non-contributory basis with a waiver of subrogation where permitted by law."

2) Limits: Our standard minimum limits are included on the vendor onboarding form; commercial GL of $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate is required unless waived by procurement.

3) Required paperwork to move to PO creation:
   - COI with the endorsement language above (endorsement page attached to COI)
   - Signed W-9 (US vendors) or applicable tax form
   - Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)

We can issue a temporary conditional PO (PO_12345-CT) to allow activation while the endorsed COI is being routed, but final PO issuance and invoice payment requires the endorsed COI + W-9. Invoices should be routed to billing@redwood.ai and uploaded to our vendor portal (link below). Payment terms: Net30 from invoice receipt after activation.

I attached the vendor onboarding form for your team to complete and a sample PO format. Ben — looping you for any commercial exceptions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0210

- Payment routing: please submit invoices to billing@redwood.ai and upload them to the vendor portal: https://vendor-portal.redwood.ai/activate/12345-CT. Include the PO number on the invoice header.
- Payment terms are Net30 unless you have an existing negotiated term with our finance team — if so, please flag and we’ll escalate.

Certificate details for the endorsement:
